Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s), other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed in the side elevations .elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.

<p><u style="">Disposal of Surface Water</u></p><p style="padding-bottom:0cm; padding-left:0cm; padding-right:0cm; padding-top:0cm">The development other than demolition works, hereby permitted shall not commence until details of the works for the disposal of surface water to be provided on site have been submitted to, and agreed in writing by, the local planning authority. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the works so agreed and the works shall thereafter be retained.</p><p style="padding-bottom:0cm; padding-left:0cm; padding-right:0cm; padding-top:0cm">REASON: To ensure that adequate drainage facilities are provided</p>
description: Two storey front extension, single and two storey side and rear extensions; first floor side extension; Juliette balcony to rear at first floor level; new roof with raised ridge height; two rear dormers, rooflights in front and both side roof slopes and crown; conversion of garage to habitable room; solar panels on both side roof slopes; external insulation to existing external walls; alterations to fenestration; raised patio with steps to side and rear;  external alterations (demolition of conservatory and shed)
